class.name: VoxelProxyBuilder
class.brief_description: Builds far-field voxel splat proxies from meshes and MultiMesh instances.
class.description: Samples the surfaces of added meshes by area, merges the samples into a voxel grid and emits one camera-facing splat per occupied voxel ([method build]), or builds voxel levels for a [VoxelField3D], which picks a level per brick on the GPU ([method build_field]). Each voxel keeps the area-weighted centroid, mean normal and linear albedo of the surfaces inside it, and its splat, a disc, shrinks with coverage, so sparse foliage stays sparse at a distance instead of turning into solid blocks. Albedo comes from [BaseMaterial3D] albedo color, the mean color of its albedo texture and, when the material uses vertex color as albedo, vertex and instance colors. Use the result as a distant stand-in, for example with [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_begin] on the proxy and [member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_end] on the source. Splats face whichever camera renders them, shadow cameras included. Place proxies without rotation shear; scale and rotation are supported by the splat shader. [b]Note:[/b] Experimental. The proxy is an ordinary [ArrayMesh] with a [ShaderMaterial]; it does not change how the source meshes render.

method.name: add_mesh
method.description: Adds the triangle surfaces of [param mesh], placed by [param transform]. [param modulate] multiplies the albedo of surfaces whose material uses vertex color as albedo. Samples of each mesh are cached, so adding the same mesh many times is cheap.

method.name: add_multimesh
method.description: Adds every visible instance of [param multimesh] (3D transforms only), placed by [param transform] times the instance transform. Instance colors modulate albedo like [method add_mesh].

method.name: build
method.description: Returns a splat mesh of the samples inside [param bounds], with cubic voxels whose edge is the longest side of [param bounds] divided by [param resolution] (1 to 1024). Returns [code]null[/code] when no sample lies inside. Mesh coordinates are those of the added transforms.

method.name: build_field
method.description: Returns voxel levels of the samples inside [param bounds] for a [VoxelField3D]. The voxel grid is a cube on the longest side of [param bounds]; the finest level has [param resolution] voxels along its edge (a power of two up to 1024), and each coarser level merges 2×2×2 voxels, summing their area so coverage stays physical, down to [param brick_resolution] voxels (a power of two). The cube is split into [param brick_resolution]³ bricks, each holding at most 64 finest voxels per edge. Set [member sample_spacing] to at most half a finest voxel. Returns [code]null[/code] when no sample lies inside.

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all added samples. The per-mesh sample cache is kept.

method.name: get_sample_count
method.description: Returns the number of surface samples added so far.

method.name: get_splat_shader
method.description: Returns the splat shader shared by every proxy this builder creates.

members.member: Maximum distance between surface samples, in mesh units. Use at most half the planned voxel size. Changing it clears the per-mesh sample cache.
